alertas_cidade.title: City alerts
alertas_cidade.description: Creates flooding sensors per zone (North, South, East, West and Center), counters, the CGE bulletin and cameras for the rain radar (current image and last-hour animation) and the alert map. In Configure, pick people or zones to know whether it's raining there.

data.geocodificar: Show flooding spots on the map
data.intervalo_adaptativo: Update less often when no rain is forecast

data_description.geocodificar: CGE doesn't publish coordinates. With this option, each flooded street is looked up on OpenStreetMap to find its approximate position.
data_description.intervalo_adaptativo: Alerts every 10 minutes and radar every 5 when the CGE forecast shows rain in the next 12 hours, or there is flooding or a region on alert (radar also when it shows rain); otherwise alerts every 30 minutes and radar every 15.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the CGE website

data.geocodificar: Show flooding spots on the map

data_description.geocodificar: CGE doesn't publish coordinates. With this option, each flooded street is looked up on OpenStreetMap to find its approximate position.
data_description.entidades_proximidade: People, trackers or zones (add zone.home for your home). Each one gets radar rain sensors: whether it's raining there, the intensity and the distance to the nearest rain. With flooding spots on the map turned on, it also gets a sensor with how many flooding spots are within the radius.
data_description.raio_km: Straight-line distance to flooding spots. Their positions are approximate, so start with 2 to 3 km.
data_description.intervalo_adaptativo: Alerts every 10 minutes and radar every 5 when the CGE forecast shows rain in the next 12 hours, or there is flooding or a region on alert (radar also when it shows rain); otherwise alerts every 30 minutes and radar every 15.

layout_alterado.title: CGE - SP: the website changed ({parte})
layout_alterado.description:
Couldn't read {parte} on the CGE website ({url}). The page layout has probably changed, and the sensors that depend on it are unavailable.

Error: `{erro}`

This warning goes away on its own once reading works again. If it persists, check the Marketplace (or HACS) for a new version of the integration or open an issue on GitHub.
